themes.name: Chrome Oasis
themes.description: Palm Springs architecture glimpsed through a CRT monitor at midnight — swimming-pool turquoise against deep desert navy, rendered in high-gloss detail with generous breathing room between each image.

props.text: A CRT blinks on at midnight. Palm Springs concrete glows turquoise in the cathode light. High-gloss stillness. Desert air, pool-cold.
Swimming-pool turquoise. Midnight architecture. High gloss, wide breath.

themes.name: Azulejo Evening
themes.description: Cobalt geometry meets warm tin-glazed parchment — a Portuguese tile wall catching the last golden hour, rendered as a measured editorial journal.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: A tile wall at dusk. Cobalt geometry pressed into warm parchment — the geometry of prayer, the patience of craft, the last raking light before evening.

themes.name: Harbourmaster's Red
themes.description: Baltic industrial quiet — birch-cold grotesque headlines crashing against humanist body text, one furious red cutting through fogged tin and pale warehouse linen.

props.text: One furious red in a warehouse of fog. The grotesque hits first — blunt, cold, birch-stripped — then Lora softens the landing like rope on a bollard. No decoration survives this dock.
Fog-cold type, one cut of red — the dock holds.

themes.name: Ivory & Blare
themes.description: A morning-bright playground that borrows the energy of a jazz poster—bold condensed type punching through a clean ivory field, with one saturated brass accent that anchors the whole composition.

props.text: Condensed. Punchy. Morning-lit. One brass note loud enough to carry the whole room.

themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Niemeyer terrace translated into precise information architecture — generous proportions, deep structural shadow, and a palette pulled from lime plaster, rosewood, and pool-lit interior grey.

props.text: A Niemeyer terrace doesn't ask permission to occupy space. Neither does this UI. Lime plaster meets rosewood — information architecture as civic gesture.
Fraunces + Karla — structural serif anchored by utilitarian sans

themes.name: Wet Geometry
themes.description: Rain-slicked streets at the edge of sleep — deep charcoal surfaces, magenta luminescence, and cinematic type that cuts through atmospheric haze.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Rain-slicked streets at the edge of sleep. Magenta cuts through the haze like neon on wet asphalt — cinematic, restless, precise.

themes.name: Pressed & Still
themes.description: A night-reading journal where deep umber paper and precisely weighted Garamond type hold a single warm accent like candlelight on a closed page.

props.text: A single flame held against umber dark. Garamond was made for patience — for the reader who underlines in pencil and returns.
